caption: The drawing features a single ornate wooden sofa placed against a plain, light beige background. The sofa has a predominantly brown wooden frame with curved armrests and legs, and stands on four small casters. The upholstery is cream or light beige in color, heavily decorated with a repeating pattern of bright red and pink flowers, green leaves, and brown stems. Prominently, on the backrest there are two green, red, and yellow birds facing each other with their heads turned slightly toward the center. The signature "WM. MILLS" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Sofa
